info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Parking Reservations Violations-v4-spec
info.description: The Parking Reservation Violations Retrieval API allows users to access detailed information about violations associated with parking reservations. This endpoint is designed for city officials, parking management services, and developers requiring insights into parking compliance. Consumers can retrieve violation data to evaluate compliance trends, manage parking policies, and enhance operational efficiencies. The API ensures that decision-makers have access to essential metrics for managing community parking effectively.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve a list of violations associated with reservations. Use this endpoint to monitor and manage any discrepancies in your reservations.

requestBody.description: This request body allows the client to retrieve information regarding reservations that have violations associated with them. The structure of the request must conform to the specified schema to ensure proper handling of the request.

200.description: Request completed successfully and violations retrieved.
